title: Salon et réseautage
goal: Se présenter et créer des contacts dans un salon.
points: L'« elevator pitch » : te présenter en 30 secondes, qui tu es, ce que tu fais et pour qui.
Pour ouvrir la conversation : « What line of business are you in? » = dans quel secteur travaillez-vous ?
Échange les contacts : « Here's my card. » ou « Could I have your card? »
Relance après le salon : « It was a pleasure meeting you at the fair in Lagos. »
examples: What line of business are you in?
We help importers move goods from Lomé to the Sahel.
Nous aidons les importateurs à acheminer leurs marchandises de Lomé vers le Sahel.
Here's my card. Let's keep in touch.
Voici ma carte. Restons en contact.
It was a pleasure meeting you at the fair.
Ce fut un plaisir de vous rencontrer au salon.

exercises.prompt: Comment demandes-tu poliment le secteur d'activité de quelqu'un ?
options: What line of business are you in?
What is your work line?
Which business you do?
In what business you are?
exercises.explain: Formule naturelle : « What line of business are you in? ».

exercises.sentence: I'll follow ___ with an email next week.
options: up
on
after
in
exercises.explain: « to follow up » = relancer, faire un suivi.

exercises.audio: Here's my card. Let's keep in touch.
options: Here's my card. Let's keep in touch.
Here's my car. Let's keep in touch.
Here's my card. Let's get in touch.
Here's my card. Let's keep in tune.
exercises.explain: « to keep in touch » = rester en contact.

exercises.fr: Ce fut un plaisir de vous rencontrer au salon.
exercises.answer: It was a pleasure meeting you at the fair
exercises.explain: « It was a pleasure meeting you » : formule de politesse après une rencontre.

exercises.sentence: Could I ___ your business card, please?
options: have
make
do
give
exercises.explain: « Could I have your card? » est la demande la plus naturelle et polie.

exercises.prompt: Quel est le meilleur début d'« elevator pitch » ?
options: We help importers move goods from Lomé to the Sahel, quickly and safely.
My company was created in 2015 and we have many trucks and also an office.
I am very happy to be here today at this fair.
Do you want to buy something?
exercises.explain: Un bon pitch dit tout de suite ce que tu fais et pour qui.
« to stay in touch » ou « to keep in touch » = rester en contact.

exercises.audio: It was a pleasure meeting you at the fair in Lagos.
options: It was a pleasure meeting you at the fair in Lagos.
It was a pleasure meeting you at the fair in Lomé.
It was a pleasure meeting you at the airport in Lagos.
It's a pleasure meeting you at the fair in Lagos.
exercises.explain: Formule de relance après un salon professionnel.

exercises.text: What line of business are you in?

author: claude
